D016-D012_h001.question: "Well, doc, everything just feels…off. It's been a solid six months now, maybe more, and I just can't shake this constant knot in my stomach. I've become absolutely convinced I’m going to get some terrible illness, probably something I picked up from one of the dusty old estates I visit. I wash my hands raw even when I'm at home, and I find myself checking the doorknobs and the stove burners over and over before I leave for work, then again before bed. My wife thinks I’m losing it. It's not just the illness, either. I feel jumpy, like danger is lurking around every corner, whether it's a fall, or something even worse.
